initial_message_count_pick.rule: ceil(max visible rows across viewports) + 3, clamped to 10..25

stop_condition.rule: Trip if (A) chat transfer (tap-window wire KiB over 9 Mbps) > 50% of chat tap median, OR (B) span time of the message window plus every deferrable segment < 30 ms AND client TaskDuration falls by < 20 ms when only initial_message_count is flipped to N on the running node.
stop_condition.verdict: not tripped: the smaller-first-frame lever stands

deferred_set_for_stage_3.rule: every enter_space segment over 3 ms median (before run) that is not needed to paint the composer and the message list

stage3_deferred_set.rule: defer only what is measured: every enter_space segment over 3 ms median not needed to paint the composer and the message list
stage3_deferred_set.measured_on: task branch after stage 2 (initial_message_count 10, batched edited-count query), chat only, same fixture/link/compress, 10 taps
stage3_deferred_set.verdict: empty: only message_window (needed for first paint) is over 3 ms; deferred_side_state stays []

stage4_after_run.note: Task 01a17bf4 stage 4. Same fixture, user, proxy shaper (9/1.5 Mbps, 85 ms), compress on, 10 taps per tab, on this machine. Load average (1 min) at start: before 2.34, after 2.41, so within 2x and the full before-run was not repeated. Chat was additionally re-run back to back on the before build (409b4d1a6) and on the branch, at 1280x800 and 390x844 (the before-run had no 390x844 chat run). Local seeded, shaped link, not prod.
stage4_after_run.keep_alive_rule: sticky is warranted if chat (or any tab) stays above 288 ms (2 x the 144 ms stage-1 small-tab median), or if the remaining cost is the 85 ms round-trip floor that only a kept view removes
